description:
Ship the 'read_file' built-in tool: the simplest of the two v0.3 tools, landed first so it validates the ball-#1 contract end-to-end before bash lands.

=== Scope ===

- 'lernie tool read_file' subcommand on the lernie binary (per ball #1's pinned shape for in-process tools).
- JSON input describing the path to read (exact argv/stdin shape pinned by ball #1).
- JSON Schema at schemas/tools/read_file.json describing the input per the Anthropic tools contract — loaded by the harness when assembling 'tools: [...]' (v0.3 assembly may be hardcoded; broader surface arrives with workflow.yaml in v0.6).
- SKILL.md under template/.agent/system/tools/read_file/SKILL.md per §3.3. Frontmatter { name, description } + body describing when to reach for it.
- Integration test: end-to-end through the tool executor (ball #4), against a fixture conversation repo.

=== Depends on ===

bl-7c2a — the executor is the thing that invokes this tool.

=== Out of scope ===

- Binary-safe mode / partial-read offsets / line-range semantics. v0.3 reads the whole file and returns its content. If the file exceeds some sensible cap, the tool errors; oversized-output auto-dispatch that would otherwise handle this is deferred (epic non-goal).
title: v0.3 built-in tool: read_file
